source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: At either [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase)’s opening, pick up to one foe engaged with the Marshal’s unit. Roll a D6 for the foe. It takes D3 [mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds) on **2–3**, 3 [mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds) on **4–5**, or D3+3 [mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds) on **6+**.
